Class CannonTower

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Tower
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.towers.CannonTower
Direct Known Subclasses:
J2dCannonTower
public abstract class CannonTower extends Tower
A slow, high-damage tower that fires cannonballs at the highest-HP enemy in range.

Default stats:

  • range: 2.5 game-world units
  • damage: 60 per direct hit
  • fire rate: 0.6 shots per second
  • cost: 100 gold
  • size: 0.9 × 0.9 units

Splash damage: the tower's splash stats (splashRadius + splashDamage) are passed to the CannonProjectile it fires. The area damage is applied inside CannonProjectile.onHit() when the projectile lands — the tower itself does not apply damage. The splash damage is a fraction of the base damage (default 40%).

Targeting strategy (Java Streams): targets the enemy with the highest current HP in range, maximising splash value against clustered tanky enemies and prioritising armoured enemies.

Abstract because render() from Entity is not implemented here; J2dCannonTower extends this class and implements it.

  • Method Details

    • findTarget

      public Optional<Enemy> findTarget(List<Enemy> enemies)
      Finds the alive enemy with the most current HP within this tower's range.

      Streams usage: filter keeps alive enemies within range, then max picks the one with the highest current health. Prioritising high-HP targets maximises splash effectiveness and ensures armoured enemies are dealt with before they reach the base.

      Specified by:
      findTarget in class Tower
      Parameters:
      enemies - the current list of enemies
      Returns:
      the highest-HP enemy in range, or Optional.empty() if none is in range
